item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import work\\n\\np0={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':3,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':False,'environment':False}\\ndef chk(req, pol, want):\\n r=work.evaluate(req,pol); assert r==want,(r,want)\\nchk({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},p0,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None})\\nfor key,val in [('b',0),('i',False),('s',1),('i',None)]: chk({'layers':[{key:val}]},p0,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'})\\nchk({'layers':[{'x':1}]},p0,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'})\\np1={**p0,'null_resets':True}\\nchk({'layers':[{'i':9},{'i':None}]},p1,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':3,'s':'x'},'error':None})\\np2={**p0,'environment':True}\\nchk({'layers':[],'environment':{'b':'false','i':'-04','s':''}},p2,{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':-4,'s':''},'error':None})\\nfor key,val in [('b','False'),('b','1'),('i',' 1'),('i','1.0'),('i',True),('s',3)]: chk({'environment':{key:val}},p2,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'})\\nchk({'environment':{'i':'1'}},p0,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'})\\nchk({'environment':{'x':'1'}},p2,{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'})\\nprint('all assertions passed')\"]}"}
